pointsCles: Q2 26: revenue $119.8B (+24%, 12th straight double-digit quarter, beat ~$2.8B); operating income +30% to $40.8B (34% margin); GAAP EPS $9.11 dominated by ~$98B of UNREALIZED equity-portfolio gains in OI&E - recurring base ~$4.55, bridged in quarterlyEPS; Q2 FCF negative (-$5.9B) on $44.9B quarterly capex.

Cloud is the story: +82% to $24.8B with operating margin 35.6% (vs 20.7%, OI x3), backlog $514B (+>$50B sequential, >50% to revenue within 24 months), first TPU SYSTEM deliveries to customer data centers (revenue mostly 2027), ~90% of Fortune 100 on Gemini Enterprise, ~500 customers >1T tokens/year.

Search resilient at scale: +17% to $63.3B - AI Mode >1B MAU with INCREMENTAL queries, AI Max out of beta (0.5M advertisers, +15% conversions at similar ROAS), all-time-high search usage during the World Cup; YouTube ads +13% with subscriptions growing faster than ads.

Investment cycle steepens: FY26 capex raised to $195-205B and 2027 'significantly' higher; debt grown $16B -> ~$100B in a year plus an equity raise (balance-sheet resilience; ATM only for SBC tax); third-party bridge compute accepted at high short-term cost for multiyear ROI; Gemini 4 pretraining underway with a near-monthly release cadence targeted - coding gap acknowledged and closing (3.6 Flash +10pts DeepSWE in 6 weeks).

hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
The full-stack AI thesis strengthens: Cloud accelerated to +82% (from +63% in Q1) with a 514bn backlog and operating margin tripled to 35.6%, while Search & other (+17%) and YouTube Ads (+13%) still show no generative-AI cannibalization. The structural change this refresh is financial, not operational: buybacks are fully suspended (0 in H1 26 vs 28.3bn a year earlier), 84bn+ of debt was raised, and FY26 capex was lifted to 195-205bn with a further significant increase flagged for 2027.

== THESIS READ ==
- The monetization engine is outrunning the fear narrative: Search/YouTube growth is intact while Cloud converts the AI build-out into margin at scale. Watch: Cloud backlog conversion pace and margin durability.
- Capital allocation pivoted hard: buyback suspension + debt issuance means the share count creeps UP near-term (12,280 -> 12,350 by 2027) before resuming its decline. Watch: any buyback restart signal - it would also restore the 0%-yield cash convention (E5-a bis rule 3 vs 4).
- Net cash swings to ~0 by 2028 at the guided capex pace before rebuilding. Watch: 2027 capex guidance (flagged higher) and FCF trough depth.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Base = GAAP retreated ONLY of unrealized securities-revaluation gains (below the operating line); consensus tracks a broader basis - the 2026 gap (Omnium 11.90 vs street 14.22) is basis-driven and documented in the scorecard. Preferred-dividend drag included. Conversion ~85% kept for methodological continuity; the growing financial-income line is now explicit in the bridge.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
Revenue +24% 2026 fading to +11% by 2030; EBIT margin 34.5% -> 38.5%; ETR 16.5% normative; finNet +3.1bn growing to +5.7bn (cash income net of preferred dividends). Published 2025 reconciles at ~0 residual. Watch: DOJ remedies implementation; Gemini monetization disclosures; Waymo capitalization.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 (Oct); 2027 capex framing; buyback restart; antitrust-remedy milestones; Waymo external funding rounds.

ancrages.moteur: Cloud +82% in Q2 26 (against +63% in Q1), Cloud operating margin more than tripled to 35,6%, backlog taken to 514 Mds$ (against 462 Mds$ in Q1); modest margin pressure expected in Q3 owing to the use of third-party capacity as a bridge, then normalisation expected.
Search & other +17% and YouTube Ads +13% in Q2 26: no cannibalisation observed over two consecutive quarters since the rollout of AI Overviews/AI Mode.

2026 capex guidance raised to 195-205 Mds$ (from 180-190 Mds$) and confirmation of a further significant increase in 2027 (sell-side consensus ~257-262 Mds$): lasting and growing pressure on the margin via D&A as the funded capacity comes into service.

Buybacks entirely suspended since Q1 26 (0$ over the first two quarters of 2026, against 28,3 Mds$ over the same period in 2025) in favour of an equity raise of 84,75 Mds$ (common shares + mandatory convertible preferred + a 40 Mds$ ATM programme undrawn at end-June) intended to fund AI capex: the diluted share count rises over the near horizon instead of receding, with a hypothetical resumption of buybacks from 2028 once the capex peak has passed.

Mark-to-market revaluation gains on unlisted securities (Anthropic, SpaceX): +28,7 Mds$ in Q1 26 then +77,1 Mds$ in Q2 26 (out of a pre-tax gain of 99,0 Mds$, EPS effect +6,26$), classified as a non-operating financial one-off and excluded in full from omniumNet/omniumEPS across the whole horizon, in line with the treatment adopted for Amazon on the same underlying.

19 Mds$ of mandatory convertible preferred shares issued in June 2026 (6,25% dividend, ~1,19 Md$/yr on an annualised run-rate): a priority claim on net income ahead of attribution to common shareholders, a permanent but minor effect on omniumEPS until conversion or redemption.

Net cash position strengthened in the near term by the equity raise (net cash ~144 Mds$ at end-Q2 26, against ~85 Mds$ at end-2025) despite the near-doubling of long-term debt (98,2 Mds$); this cushion should erode gradually over the remainder of the year under the effect of massive capex before improving again at the end of the horizon, carried by the expected acceleration in Cloud free cash-flow.
